game.name: Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack
game.desc: The Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack collects Brad Borne's original Flash games, the series that set the bar for Flash platformers. Run, jump, slide and roll as the stick figure in the fancy pants through World 1, World 2 and World 3, picking your world from the hand drawn World 4 hub. Run fast, run fancy! Runs in the Ruffle Flash emulator; you need the game from Steam.
